Alex N.: Heads up — I sketched a tiny change that lets the Console push a temporary routing override to active requests for emergency circuit-breaking (live policy). 

Alex N.: Current plan is to surface it as an ephemeral header: `X-Redwood-Live-Route` so it flows through proxies and SDKs. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321 :eyes:

Maya S.: fyi this will touch py/ts/go SDKs — how invasive is the header parsing?

Jordan P.: for most SDKs it's just pass-through metadata, but we currently canonicalize and scrub headers in the proxy. If Console starts injecting intent-like headers we need a clear contract.

Sam C.: my main worry is telemetry & quotas. If a live override routes a tenant to a cheaper model pool, quota accounting must attribute to the tenant not the fallback route. We should add a policy assertion header instead of mutating the actual route id.

Alex N.: good point. Proposal in PR: header is opaque token `lrv_...` that the routing plane resolves server-side into route decisions. SDKs need only forward it, no interpretation. Example: `X-Redwood-Live-Route: lrv_abc123`

Maya S.: that minimizes SDK changes (just ensure clients don't remove unknown headers). But older SDKs might still strip unknown headers in the HTTP client. Which versions do we need to support?

Jordan P.: target: maintainers want zero user-facing breaking changes. For Python <1.4 we still set default `headers_sanitize=True` which drops unknown headers. Patch options:
- patch SDKs to opt-out of sanitization for `X-Redwood-Live-Route`
- or add a proxy shim that maps `X-Redwood-Live-Route` -> `X-Redwood-Internal-Route` server-side after auth

Sam C.: proxy shim looks safer ops-side, but then telemetry loses explicit client intent unless we copy header into trace metadata post-auth. We should mirror it into `x-rw-trace` for observability.

Alex N.: ops plan: proxy will copy into trace and metrics, but only after token auth matches tenant. That preserves attribution. SDK change is minimal: add an environment toggle `REDWOOD_FORWARD_LIVE_ROUTE=true` and a one-line update in our default headers allowlist in the latest release.

Maya S.: rollout UX question: Console will let SREs flip live overrides. We want a gradual rollout — only tenants in the beta org should see header injection for 48h. Need SDK telemetry flag to mark requests that saw the header so we can A/B metrics.

Jordan P.: we can add a lightweight boolean metric event `client.received_live_route` emitted by SDKs when the header is present in server responses or when SDK forwards it in requests. But SDKs currently don't emit client-level events to infra. We can piggyback on existing telemetry ping: include `received_live_route=true` in the periodic usage ping.

Sam C.: quotas: ensure per-tenant quota ledger uses resolved route mapping server-side. Also add a reconciliation job to detect mismatches where a tenant's billed model != console expectation (daily diff job).

Alex N.: agreed. Action items:
- Alex: update PR to clarify header is opaque token and show server-side resolution flow (done)
- Maya: small SDK patch to add header to allowlist + env var, target python v1.4.2 / ts v2.3.0 (ETA EOD)
